_meta.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (datasets ehs5-yac3, sruw-w49i, n4pw-9ygw); Grain Transportation Report
_meta.notes: Grain ocean freight to Japan (Gulf vs PNW), weekly export inspections by port region and weekly barged grain at the Mississippi/Ohio/Arkansas/Illinois locks. Monthly baseline = 2019-2025 same-month mean; weekly baseline = 2021-2025 same-week median.

ocean_gulf_japan.label: Ocean freight, US Gulf to Japan (grain)
ocean_gulf_japan.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)
ocean_gulf_japan.notes: Monthly average of Maritime Research, Inc. fixtures as reported in the GTR.

ocean_pnw_japan.label: Ocean freight, US Pacific Northwest to Japan (grain)
ocean_pnw_japan.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)

ocean_gulf_pnw_spread.label: Gulf minus PNW ocean freight to Japan (spread)
ocean_gulf_pnw_spread.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)

inspections_us_gulf.label: Grain inspected for export, US Gulf (Mississippi + Texas)
inspections_us_gulf.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)
inspections_us_gulf.notes: All grains inspected for export (FGIS), week ending Thursday; includes revisions, so recent weeks can differ slightly from the printed GTR Table 18.

inspections_ms_gulf.label: Grain inspected for export, Mississippi Gulf
inspections_ms_gulf.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)
inspections_ms_gulf.notes: All grains inspected for export (FGIS), week ending Thursday; includes revisions, so recent weeks can differ slightly from the printed GTR Table 18.

inspections_pnw.label: Grain inspected for export, Pacific Northwest
inspections_pnw.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)
inspections_pnw.notes: All grains inspected for export (FGIS), week ending Thursday; includes revisions, so recent weeks can differ slightly from the printed GTR Table 18.

barge_grain_total.label: Downbound grain barged (Mississippi L27 + Ohio Olmsted + Arkansas L1)
barge_grain_total.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)
barge_grain_total.notes: USACE lock data via the GTR; week ending Saturday; all grains (corn, wheat, soybeans, other). Same three locks as the GTR weekly total.

barge_ms_lock27.label: Downbound grain barged, Mississippi River Locks 27
barge_ms_lock27.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)
barge_ms_lock27.notes: USACE lock data via the GTR; week ending Saturday; all grains (corn, wheat, soybeans, other).

barge_il_lagrange.label: Downbound grain barged, Illinois River La Grange
barge_il_lagrange.source: USDA AMS AgTransport (Grain Transportation Report data)
barge_il_lagrange.notes: USACE lock data via the GTR; week ending Saturday; all grains (corn, wheat, soybeans, other). Upstream of L27, so already inside the Mississippi total.

unavailable.reason: No official series found. FGIS inspections record port region and destination, not transit route; the AgTransport catalog (454 views, checked 2026-09-24) and the GTR of 2026-09-17 carry no Panama Canal grain-transit table.
